paylink.title: Pay the advance for your order
paylink.why: We send your order as soon as this advance is in. The rest is paid as agreed with our team.
paylink.test: Test payment page: no money is taken. The real payment page comes when the payment service is connected.
paylink.failed: The payment did not go through. Your order is saved — you can try again.
paylink.paid: Thank you — the advance is paid. Your order goes ahead now.
paylink.closed: This pay link is not open any more. If you still need to pay, please call us.
paylink.redirect: You will pay on {method}'s own secure page, then come back here.
paylink.unavailable: Online payment is not open right now. Your order is saved — please try again a little later, or call us.
paylink.notFound: This pay link was not found. Please check the link in your message, or call us.

err.network: No connection. Please check your internet and try again.
err.other: Something went wrong. Please try again.
